name: Comic burst
summary: Jagged comic-book speech burst with a bold outline and a word that pops in, like POW! or BAM!; for punchlines.

params.name: r
params.note: outer radius of the burst in px

params.name: size
params.note: font size of the word; shrinks to fit

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different spike pattern

params.name: color
params.note: word colour; default the style accent

author: krakujs
